summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on configuring and optimizing the ClickHouse cluster architecture. Decisions were made regarding the deployment of new nodes (clickhouse05, clickhouse06) with specific instance types (m7g.2xlarge). The initial plan for sharding was refined to use 300/300 GB disk sizes for hot/cold data on these new nodes.

A major effort involved updating the cluster configuration files across all servers using Ansible, including adding necessary macro definitions (`shard: s_{{server_id%2}}`, `replica: r_{{server_id}}`) and ensuring proper replication paths. The team discussed implementing a load balancer (proxy) to manage connections between nodes.

The conversation concluded with plans for potential future scaling of specific servers, such as upgrading clickhouse03 to m7g.4xlarge.
decisions: New nodes (clickhouse05, clickhouse06) will be provisioned using m7g.2xlarge instances.
The disk sizes for hot/cold data on the new nodes are set to 300/300 GB.
Cluster configuration files across all servers must be updated with specific macros and replication paths.
A load balancer (proxy) solution is being investigated for connection management.
action_items: Implement the cluster configuration updates on all relevant servers.
Test a proxy/load balancing mechanism to manage connections between ClickHouse nodes.
Monitor and plan potential future scaling, such as upgrading clickhouse03.
